title: salix hastata f. tenuifolia-angustifolia
intro: Salix hastata f. tenuifolia-angustifolia, commonly known as narrow-leaved willow, is a plant species within the Salix genus. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain due to its anti-inflammatory and analgesic effects. The health benefits of narrow-leaved willow include its potential to lower fever, soothe digestive issues, and alleviate headaches, thanks to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, salicylic acid, and other phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
